Name: Kid Leo for Ginger Island NPC Overhaul
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
Uploaded with permission.

[s]Currently only the Melanesian portraits are available, but I might make the second set later.[/s] Both Melanesian and Malaysian versions work! If you download this mod, then later change your mind on which portrait you use, you can simply change it in this mod's config, no need to uninstall/disable it. ("Melanesian" is the default option which makes Leo's portrait be the one I'm including with this mod, "Malaysian" [s]is a stretch option for the future so that it's easy to update if and when I make it that currently causes the mod to do nothing[/s], also works now and "None" is an explicit "do nothing" command)

The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9242]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/url] mod is a strict requirement, if it's not loaded this mod won't load / do anything either.

Other mods in screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19503]Seasonal Farmer Looks[/url] and attendant Fashion Sense content, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19444]Purple Clover Interface[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6899]Portrait Frame Variations[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13730]Fancy Clocks[/url]
